remarks: Spacious 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home for sale in Simi Valley offering 2,028 square feet of living space, a large primary suite with private balcony, and an expansive backyard with pool and spa. The front entry opens to the living room featuring crown moulding, laminate wood flooring, a fireplace with stone surround, and large windows providing plenty of natural light. The adjacent dining room leads into the remodeled kitchen featuring newer cabinetry, granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, recessed lighting, and tile flooring.
